name: crack_lowers_armor_for_all_and_credits_help
description: The Chime Post's crack (design 3.2, contract-m6 3): a creep inside the post's 2.5 tiles has 2 less armour against every tower's hits, so the Lamplighter's 8-damage arrow does 6 to a Thornback (armour 4), not 4; a Deep Chime's 4 lets it through whole. The strongest crack applies, never two at once (of two as strong, the lower id's): with the Deep Chime sold, the other Bellfounder's plain post holds it, and its seat earns the Help. Help: each hit on a cracked creep is the cracking seat's Help, in full, once; nobody earns Help from their own crack. Fliers carry no armour, and the post never reaches them.

steps.assert: t[1].crack_c == 200 and t[2].crack_c == 200 and t[1].id < t[2].id
